The engine is surrounded by other engines and parts in a cluttered yard or workshop.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the front of the engine, including belts, pulleys, and the intake manifold.
Photo 2 shows a wider view with multiple engines, including the red-capped one in the foreground and others in the background.
The red engine has a red valve cover with some text, possibly 'HONDA', but it is partially obscured and not clearly readable.
